## Technical Expertise & Stack Summary
- **Backend & Automation**: Python (Pyrogram, PyTgCalls, AsyncIO, FastAPI), Go (Goroutines, high-throughput bots), PHP (Zero-framework standalone APIs), Node.js, Express
- **Frontend & Web Apps**: TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS v4, Progressive Web Apps (PWA)
- **Mobile & Embedded Platforms**: Flutter / Dart for Android Smartphones and Android TV (D-pad optimized interfaces)
- **Artificial Intelligence & LLMs**: OpenAI API, Google Gemini API, Groq, Whisper STT, Custom TTS pipelines, System command execution
- **Security & Applied Cryptography**: Zero-knowledge architectures, XChaCha20-Poly1305, AES-256-GCM, Argon2id key derivation, client-side encryption
- **Databases & Infrastructure**: MongoDB, Redis, SQLite, Docker containerization, Linux VPS administration, Cloudflare Workers & DNS

## Flagship Open-Source Projects

### 1. VenomMusic — High-Fidelity Music Streaming Platform
- **Category**: Multimedia Streaming / Android & Web
- **Description**: Free, ad-free music streaming platform delivering millions of songs at 320 kbps with live synced lyrics, offline caching, and no required registration. Includes an intelligent server-side catalog layer that dynamically resolves and decrypts stream URLs on the fly.
- **Tech Stack**: TypeScript, PWA, Android Native, Audio Decryption Engine
- **Live Platform**: [https://venomm.dpdns.org](https://venomm.dpdns.org)
- **APK Download**: [https://apkpure.com/p/com.blazenxt.venommusic](https://apkpure.com/p/com.blazenxt.venommusic)

### 2. VibeTube — Flutter Android YouTube Client
- **Category**: Mobile Application / Video Streaming
- **Description**: Lightweight open-source YouTube client for Android. Built without Google Play Services dependencies, featuring background audio playback, Picture-in-Picture (PiP), SponsorBlock API integration, and full Shorts & Live stream support.
- **Tech Stack**: Flutter, Dart, Material Design 3, SponsorBlock API
- **Live Site**: [https://code-stride.github.io/VibeTube/](https://code-stride.github.io/VibeTube/)
- **Repository**: [https://github.com/Code-Stride/VibeTube](https://github.com/Code-Stride/VibeTube)
- **Latest Release**: [VibeTube APK Direct Download](https://github.com/Code-Stride/VibeTube/releases/latest/download/VibeTube-release.apk)

### 3. Devil AI — Pure Vanilla PHP AI Chatbot
- **Category**: Artificial Intelligence / Conversational Agent
- **Description**: Production-ready AI chatbot written in 100% pure PHP with zero external dependencies and no Composer requirement. Features multi-provider LLM support (Gemini, Groq, OpenAI), built-in IP rate-limiting, and an offline mock demo mode.
- **Tech Stack**: Pure PHP 8+, Gemini API, Groq API, OpenAI API
- **Live Demo**: [https://ai.blazenxt.in](https://ai.blazenxt.in)
- **Repository**: [https://github.com/blazenxt/devil-ai](https://github.com/blazenxt/devil-ai)

### 4. vault100 — Zero-Knowledge Client-Side Encryption
- **Category**: Security / Cryptography
- **Description**: Open-source, zero-knowledge file encryption suite. Combines XChaCha20-Poly1305 and AES-256-GCM in an authenticated cascading cipher with Argon2id memory-hard key derivation. Completely runs in the browser via Web Workers; data never leaves the local machine.
- **Tech Stack**: JavaScript, Web Crypto API, Argon2id, XChaCha20-Poly1305, PWA
- **Live Demo**: [https://vault100.blazenxt.in](https://vault100.blazenxt.in)
- **Repository**: [https://github.com/blazenxt/vault100](https://github.com/blazenxt/vault100)

### 5. JARVIS — Modular AI Voice & System Assistant
- **Category**: AI Assistant / System Automation
- **Description**: Modular desktop and web system assistant. Incorporates OpenAI and Gemini reasoning cores with local speech recognition, text-to-speech audio feedback, and a futuristic holographic HUD web interface.
- **Tech Stack**: Python, SpeechRecognition, PyTTSx3, OpenAI / Gemini APIs, HTML5 HUD
- **Repository**: [https://github.com/blazenxt/JARVIS-AI-Assistant](https://github.com/blazenxt/JARVIS-AI-Assistant)

### 6. Ray Music — Instant Free Web Music Player
- **Category**: Web Application / Audio Player
- **Description**: Minimalist, instantaneous audio streaming web app focusing on speed, zero tracking, and pure performance.
- **Tech Stack**: TypeScript, HTML5 Audio, Responsive CSS
- **Live Site**: [https://venomm.dpdns.org/ray](https://venomm.dpdns.org/ray)

### 7. RickyCC — Telegram Referral & Reward Engine
- **Category**: Telegram Bot / Growth Automation
- **Description**: High-throughput Telegram referral bot written in Go and backed by MongoDB. Verifies channel memberships, tracks referral trees, and dispenses one-time unlock codes with strict concurrency locks.
- **Tech Stack**: Go (Golang), MongoDB, Telegram Bot API, Docker
- **Repository**: [https://github.com/blazenxt/RickyCC](https://github.com/blazenxt/RickyCC)

### 8. tv-browser — Android TV Web Browser
- **Category**: TV Application / Browser
- **Description**: Full-screen TV web browser engineered from the ground up for directional D-pad remote controls without requiring a mouse or physical keyboard.
- **Tech Stack**: Flutter, Dart, Android TV WebView, Leanback Controls
- **Repository**: [https://github.com/blazenxt/tv-browser](https://github.com/blazenxt/tv-browser)

### 9. AniMela — Anime Discovery & Streaming Platform
- **Category**: Web Application / Entertainment
- **Description**: Next.js and Tailwind CSS web portal for exploring anime, movies, and TV shows with genre indexing, instant search, and watchlist management.
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- **Repository**: [https://github.com/blazenxt/AniMela](https://github.com/blazenxt/AniMela)
